facts.value: Starts aerial Judgment by dividing the fighter's horizontal self-velocity by x20_GAMEWATCH_JUDGE_MOMENTUM_PRESERVE, selecting a Judge result, entering its result-relative aerial motion state at frame zero, and initializing animation and move command/accessory state. The division has no local zero check; attenuation depends on the runtime attribute value.
facts.rationale: Replaces an unconditional attenuation claim with the exact operation and its data-dependent interpretation.

evidence.why: Shows shared initialization and the complete aerial entry sequence.

facts.value: int ftGw_SpecialS_GetRandomInt(HSD_GObj* gobj), consuming a fighter object. On a cumulative-threshold match within the populated temporary entries it returns a zero-based Judge index in 0–8 and records it in fighter history. That return domain is conditional: the scan covers all nine temporary entries, including any uninitialized tail after filtering, and result has no fallback initialization if no comparison matches.
facts.rationale: Preserves the exact signature and intended result domain while making exceptional undefined behavior explicit. A valid-domain claim requires a match within populated entries, not merely any successful comparison.

evidence.why: Shows candidate construction, full-array scan, uninitialized-result warning, history writes and return.
Establishes the nine-element temporary array type.
